sentences.text: State Of Gujarat - On Behalf Of S B Bhatt, ... vs Nirmalaben

Author: B.N. Karia
Bench: B.N. Karia
 R/Cr.A/925/2012 Order

IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  LOK ADALAT  R/CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 925 of 2012 ==========================================================
 STATE OF GUJARAT - ON BEHALF OF S B BHATT, FOOD INSPECTOR  Versus

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  LOK ADALAT
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Appearance:
MR MITESH AMIN, SPECIAL PP WIH MR JK SHAH, APP for the PETITIONER(s) No. 1 for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 HCLS COMMITTEE(4998) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 MR PH BUCH(1018) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 UNSERVED EXPIRED (R)(69) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 2 ==========================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE B.N. KARIA  Date : 22/04/2018  ORAL ORDER 1. This Appeal is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat.
2. Mr. J. K. Shah, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has appeared on behalf of the State and has produced withdrawal / settlement pursis, which is taken on record.

The withdrawal / settlement pursis is signed by the authorized signatory, who is present in person before this Lok Adalat and the pursis is counter signed by learned APP and respective learned advocates.

3. It is submitted that the offence alleged against the accused under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, is not serious in R/CR.A/925/2012 ORDER nature, the penalty / punishment prescribed for such offence is not substantial in view of the Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety State Of Gujarat - On Behalf Of S B Bhatt, ... vs Nirmalaben Parsottambhai Gonghiya on 22 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21123922/
1 and Standard Act, 2006.

entities.text: Food Safety State Of Gujarat - On Behalf Of S B Bhatt, ... vs Nirmalaben Parsottambhai Gonghiya
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned advocate Mr. P. H. Buch for the respondent no.1 stated that the respondent no.2 has passed away.

It is submitted that due to poor financial condition of the respondent no.1, he has been provided legal aid by the High Court Legal Services Committee, and accordingly, he has appeared on behalf of the respondent no.1.Therefore, a request is made to take a lenient view in imposing fine by this Court.
Learned Special PP Mr. Mitesh Amin for the prosecution has consented in doing so by the Court.
5. In view of the withdrawal / compromise pursis of the parties, this Appeal stands disposed of.
The respondent No. 1 is directed to pay a sum of Rs.1,000/- (Rupees Five Thousand Only) in special circumstance towards litigation cost; as agreed between the parties, in lieu thereof.
Necessary cost be deposited in the office of the High Court Legal Services Committee within four weeks, failing which the Appeal shall stand revived automatically.
Accordingly, this appeal stands disposed of.

6. However, disposal of this matter will not affect any connected matters arising out of the same,
incidental or any other proceedings, filed or to be filed before any other Court.
It is also R/CR.A/925/2012 ORDER required to be noted that this order will not be treated as a precedent in any future case for reference.

(B.N. KARIA, J.) Chairman ksdarji State Of Gujarat - On Behalf Of S B Bhatt, ... vs Nirmalaben Parsottambhai Gonghiya on 22 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21123922/
